dedupe_keys.name: bornes de recharge irve du reseau virta

description: Bornes de recharge IRVE du réseau VIRTA is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cédric MORET. This datasets reference the IRVE charging stations of the Virta network. Coverage: Cédric MORET. The portal shows the English title as "VIRTA network IRVE charging stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cédric MORET. The listing shows 5 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
